ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v7_fixed_sign
ir.intuition: Replace unsupported ops.sign with sign via safe sign approximation; preserve original adaptive scaled bias logic and vectorization.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + eps
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_diff = delta_rank - delta_rank_mean
sq_diff = exp(2 * log(abs(delta_diff) + eps))
delta_rank_var = mean(sq_diff) + eps
beta = 0.1 * exp(-4.0 * delta_rank_var)
sign_delta_rank = delta_rank / (abs(delta_rank) + eps)
bias_dynamic = bias * sign_delta_rank * (abs(delta_rank) + 0.05) / (abs_delta_rank_mean + 0.05)
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * bias_dynamic)
margin_scale_raw = sqrt(delta_rank_var) / abs_delta_rank_mean
margin_scale = 1.8 / (1 + exp(-16 * (margin_scale_raw - 0.3)))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale
weighted_margin = alpha * scaled_margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + scaled_bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -15, 15)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = weight * loss_per_pair
loss = sum(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + eps
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    delta_diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    sq_diff = ops.exp(ops.mul(2.0, ops.log(ops.add(ops.abs(delta_diff), eps))))
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(sq_diff) + eps

    beta = ops.mul(0.1, ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(4.0, delta_rank_var))))

    # Approximate sign(delta_rank) safely without ops.sign
    sign_delta_rank = ops.div(delta_rank, ops.add(ops.abs(delta_rank), eps))

    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(bias, ops.mul(sign_delta_rank, ops.div(ops.add(ops.abs(delta_rank), 0.05), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.05))))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var), abs_delta_rank_mean)
    margin_scale = ops.mul(1.8, ops.div(ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw), ops.add(ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw), ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(16.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.3)))))))

    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss
